title: Navigating News Narratives: A Media Bias Analysis Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Curating news articles using political keywords and integrated hyperpartisan datasets, then applying an active learning scheme with manual labeling and human verification to classify bias levels.
Extracting news items related to race and social movements (e.g., Black Lives Matter), then utilizing semi-supervised learning and human annotation to identify biased words and bias levels.
Collecting and labeling news narratives regarding gender equality using a multi-stage active learning annotation framework to determine bias categories.
Incorporating existing age bias and sentiment analysis datasets, integrated into the overall corpus and categorized using an iterative human-in-the-loop annotation process.
Filtering news via LGBTQ rights keywords and leveraging semi-supervised learning with human verification to categorize the level of bias in the text.
Annotating occupational news items to identify bias dimensions, aspects, and specific biased words using a combination of manual and model-assisted labeling.
